"""Per-extension tallies for the disk usage report."""


def count_by_extension(paths):
    counts = {}
    for path in paths:
        name = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        if name.startswith("."):
            continue
        if "." in name:
            ext = name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower()
        else:
            ext = ""
        counts[ext] = counts.get(ext, 0) + 1
    return counts


def size_by_extension(entries):
    sizes = {}
    for path, size in entries:
        name = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        if name.startswith("."):
            continue
        if "." in name:
            ext = name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower()
        else:
            ext = ""
        sizes[ext] = sizes.get(ext, 0) + size
    return sizes
